cat > $TMPDIR/e.py <<'E'
import re,os,collections
T=os.environ['TMPDIR']
V={'remove':'Remove','find':'Find','report':'Report','edit':'Edit','exportData':'Export','reload':'Reload','add':'Add','dismiss':'Dismiss'}
by=collections.defaultdict(list)
for l in open(T+'/missing.txt'):
    f,n=l.split();by[f].append(int(n))
seen=collections.Counter()
for f,ns in by.items():
    s=open(f).read();pos=[0]
    for c in s:pass
    lines=s.split('\n');off=[0]
    for x in lines:off.append(off[-1]+len(x)+1)
    noun=os.path.basename(f).split('.')[0].replace('-',' ')
    for n in sorted(ns,reverse=True):
        st=off[n-1];i=s.index('<app-icon-button',st)
        assert i-st<=lines[n-1].find('<app-icon-button')+1 or True
        e=s.index('>',i)
        el=s[i:e]
        h=re.search(r'\(press\)="(\w+)\(\)"',el)[1]
        assert 'label' not in el
        seen[h]+=1
        m=re.search(r'icon="\w+"',el)
        ins=m.end()
        s=s[:i+ins]+f' label="{V[h]} {noun}"'+s[i+ins:]
    open(f,'w').write(s)
print(seen)
E
python3 $TMPDIR/e.py && npx ngc -p tsconfig.json && echo OK; node ../tools/ng-facts.mjs usages IconButtonComponent.label --root . --all | head -1
